# MadLease

> MadLease is the sublease and parking marketplace for University of Wisconsin-Madison students. Students can post subleases and parking spots, or search and contact other students directly via encrypted in-app messaging.

MadLease is a free platform built specifically for the UW-Madison community. Listings include apartments, rooms, and parking spots available for short-term or semester-length rentals in Madison, Wisconsin. Users with a `@wisc.edu` email are automatically verified.

## Full site content

- [Complete site content (markdown mirrors of all pages)](https://www.madlease.net/llms-full.txt): Clean markdown version of every public page for AI systems that cannot render JavaScript.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.madlease.net/): Landing page and platform overview
- [Browse Listings](https://www.madlease.net/listings): Searchable marketplace of all active subleases and parking spots
- [About](https://www.madlease.net/about): Who built MadLease and why
- [Contact](https://www.madlease.net/contact): Support and contact information

## How it works

1. Create an account with a `@wisc.edu` email or Google sign-in
2. Post a listing with photos, rental details, and location — or browse existing listings
3. Filter by price, bedrooms, dates, and amenities; view listings on an interactive map
4. Connect with other students via end-to-end encrypted in-app messaging
5. UW-Madison email addresses are automatically verified for trust
